models.title: CFA large-sample skewness approximation using sample s
models.summary: For at least100 observations the source approximates skewness by the average cubed deviation divided by sample standard deviation cubed.

relationship.locator: Section1.3.5.11, skewness and kurtosis formulas and explicit denominator convention
relationship.translation_notes: The corroborating NIST g1 uses s0 with denominator n, unlike CFA sample s. Since s0^2=(n-1)*s^2/n, the CFA approximation equals NISTg1*((n-1)/n)^(3/2). This explicit normalization translation corroborates the standardized moment without falsely claiming identical finite-sample estimators. U^3/U^3 cancels. Owner-PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation citation; the relationship source is the accessible corroboration.
